title: Fish Wrap with Mediterranean Salsa
description: A flavorful and refreshing Indian-inspired fish wrap with a tangy Mediterranean salsa. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Fish (canned or fresh)
ingredients.notes: Canned fish can be used for a quicker option

ingredients.name: Indian flatbread (wrap or roti)
ingredients.notes: You can also use a tortilla for a similar wrap

instructions: Preheat a pan or griddle over medium-high heat.
Season the fish with salt and pepper to taste.
Cook the fish for 2-3 minutes per side, or until it reaches a safe internal temperature of 145°F.
Warm the flatbread by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 10-15 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the Mediterranean salsa on the flatbread, then adding the cooked fish, lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, and cilantro.
Drizzle the oozy sauce over the top and fold the wrap in half to serve.
